releases.name: The Three Kingdoms of Shadows: Xuzhou
The Wraith Train: Illusory Domain
releases.summary: The Wraith Train: Illusory Domain is an immersive live-action game mixing supernatural horror and puzzles. You play a passenger trapped on a creepy train and must survive. Focused on a blood-stained Passenger Survival Rules, you have to follow the rules, uncover their hidden secrets and escape.

releases.name: Chicken_Run
releases.summary: A great space escape action game where a chicken flees a farm, triggering global collapse. Navigate crumbling 2D terrains in real-time to survive. Experience a perilous escape centered on 'Freedom' and 'Responsibility,' where your quick reflexes are key to avoiding total doom.

releases.name: TASMON: Taskbar Monsters
releases.summary: An idle RPG that lives in your taskbar. While you work, your monsters auto-battle and bring back eggs and loot. Collect 156 species, breed and awaken them, forge one-of-a-kind serial-stamped weapons, and shape every weekly update from the in-game suggestion box. Free to play.

releases.name: Crown Jewels
releases.summary: Crown Jewels is a turn-based digital board game where 2-4 players roll custom dice, collect and steal jewels, use ally powers, and race to complete a crown before rivals!

releases.name: ASCEND.exe
releases.summary: ASCEND.exe is a retro-horror incremental: build nodes, chain combos, upgrade production. Descend into the facility's abandoned sections to learn why it never stopped expanding.

releases.name: Hide & Seek
releases.summary: An online multiplayer party game with a colorful twist: hiders paint their own bodies to blend into the world. Seekers must find and tag them all before time runs out. Play with friends on PC.

releases.name: Baito Fight!!: Part-time Devil Hunter
releases.summary:
From the makers of HANA, comes a life sim JRPG for Playdate about living in an apartment complex that's infested with monsters.

Use your sick baseball skills to exterminate monsters from your neighbors' apartments as a part-time devil hunter!!

Save up money for convenience store runs, and to pay off your overdue rent!!

Make some friends along the way!!

releases.name: Twenty One Points
releases.summary: Twenty One Point is a strategy roguelike blending blackjack with deckbuilding. Beyond Hit and Stand, manage Mana to cast Awaken and Artifact skills that reshape your hand, deck, and fights. Choose a class, collect cards and artifacts, and battle through the map to forge your winning build.

releases.name: Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra 2
releases.summary:
Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra 2 is the sequel to the charming hidden object game Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra. This time, finding the cats is only the beginning: their instruments are hiding too!

Explore 10 delightful levels filled with cute details and carefully hidden surprises. Search every corner to find the cats and their instruments, then complete each musical pair to bring the orchestra back together.

Each level also hides a special key. Find it to open a treasure chest, reveal a hidden instrument, and discover the shyest cat of them all.

With 32 hidden objects in every level, Shy Cats Hidden Orchestra 2 offers a relaxing search filled with charming discoveries, musical rewards, and plenty of adorable cats.

releases.name: Gaslamp Cases 9: The Ghost of Autmaton City
releases.summary: Immerse yourself in a tale of intrigue and suspense in Automaton City, where science and superstition clash. Solve match-3 puzzle challenges to uncover clues and unlock new areas. Play the 9th part of the fantastic Match3 serial!

releases.name: Monstah
releases.summary: Monstah is a first-person horror game where the protagonist is a child trapped in a terrible dream and now must escape by killing a terrifying creature haunting his house.

releases.name: The Lady with the Dog
releases.summary: Chekhov's quiet masterpiece becomes a cinematic visual novel about longing, choice, and the impossible shape of an honest life.

releases.name: Journeybound Idle
releases.summary: Another world needed a hero. It got you instead! A long fantasy-idle RPG: climb the adventurer's guild from F-Rank to S-Rank, max your skills, clear 114 quests, discover 1,300+ items, hire companions, farm, craft, fight, and lots more! No pay-to-win, no in-game shop, no nonsense. Just gaming!

releases.name: RE:DREAM
releases.summary: RE:DREAM is a walking simulator in which the player discovers photographs. A copy of our world, or a world inside a copy. 3 real life characters, who discover their self of our reality.

releases.name: Shapes: The Tower Defense Game
releases.summary: Strategize your base to build and defend off waves of enemies in an on going battle. Plan, Attack, Defend and Grow! In the stratigic tower defense shooter.

releases.name: Arcade Mogul
releases.summary: Build the arcade of your dreams in this cozy tycoon sim. Design your floor, place hundreds of games, hire staff to keep the machines running and the crowds happy, redeem prizes, and grow a struggling little arcade and become a mogul! 196 Different Arcade Machines & Attractions.

releases.name: Muska
releases.summary: No weapons. No escape. Just silence... and a truth awaiting you. In this atmospheric psychological horror game inspired by Turkish paranormal horror, uncover the secrets of an abandoned hospital and complete the ritual.

releases.name: Marine
releases.summary: Dive into nonstop underwater chaos in Marine, a synergetic lane‑defence strategy game where quirky sea creatures battle rival kingdoms to protect their reef! Build your defence, unleash powerful combos, and survive wave after wave in this fast and charming roguelike!

releases.name: Tower Defence: Back to the roots 2
releases.summary: Tower Defence: Back to the roots 2 is a modern take on classic maze-building tower defense. Build your defense, send monsters, and outplay your opponent in strategic 1vs1 battles focused on economy, pathing, and smart tower placement.
